cases.sentence: Затем он привел меня обратно к ___ святилища, которые находились с восточной стороны.
cases.explain: «внешним воротам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

cases.sentence: Затем он привел меня обратно к внешним воротам святилища, которые находились с ___.
cases.explain: «восточной стороны» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

cases.sentence: Потом он вывел меня через ___ к дому.
cases.explain: «северные ворота» — after the preposition «через», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house; so I fell on my face.

cases.sentence: Они могут служить в Моем святилище, присматривая за ___ и участвуя в храмовых службах.
cases.explain: «храмовыми воротами» — after the preposition «за», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

cases.sentence: Они могут служить в Моем святилище, присматривая за храмовыми воротами и участвуя в ___.
cases.explain: «храмовых службах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

cases.sentence: Они могут закалывать народу животных для всесожжений и для ___ и стоять перед ним, чтобы прислуживать.
cases.explain: «других жертв» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

cases.sentence: Пусть не приближаются к Моим святыням или к Моим ___.
cases.explain: «святым приношениям» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel. Therefore I have lifted up my hand against them,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and they will bear their iniquity.

cases.sentence: На головах у них пусть будут ___, и пусть они носят льняное нижнее белье.
cases.explain: «льняные уборы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.

cases.sentence: Выходя во внешний двор к народу, пусть они снимают одежду, в которой служили, оставляют ее в ___, и надевают другую, чтобы священными одеждами не прикасаться к народу .
cases.explain: «священных комнатах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister, and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.

cases.sentence: Выходя во внешний двор к народу, пусть они снимают одежду, в которой служили, оставляют ее в священных комнатах, и надевают другую, чтобы ___ не прикасаться к народу .
cases.explain: «священными одеждами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister, and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.

cases.sentence: Пусть они не бреют голову, но и ___ пусть не распускают: пусть стригутся.
cases.explain: «длинные волосы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.

cases.sentence: Священнику нельзя осквернять себя, приближаясь к мертвому телу, но если у него умерли отец или мать, сын или дочь, брат или ___, ему дозволяется осквернить себя.
cases.explain: «незамужняя сестра» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.

cases.explain: «единственным наследием» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “ ‘They shall have an inheritance. I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel. I am their possession.

cases.sentence: Лучшее из ___ и всех ваших даров будет принадлежать священникам.
cases.explain: «первых плодов» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for the priest. You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.

cases.sentence: Священникам нельзя есть ни птицу, ни животное, найденное мертвым или растерзанным ___».
cases.explain: «дикими зверями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself, or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.
